semanticReview.method: R33 source follow-up: reopened the article and prior review; consulted free institutional material; compared claims with locatable pages/sections; partial support is not extended to unsupported claims.
findings: Irodori identifica いい como caso especial y respalda よかった; el material también muestra いい como adjetivo y よくない como negativo.

Irodori, Grammar notes, PDF p. 46 (Lesson 15 adjective chart) lists いい and explicitly gives いい → よくない; PDF p. 54 (Lesson 17 section ➌) says いい is special and its past form is よかったです. The material directly supports these forms.
limitations: La fuente revisada no desarrolla suficientemente el paradigma completo いい／よい, su uso adverbial よく y los compuestos como かっこいい; no se validan todas las afirmaciones ni ejemplos.
The reference supports the irregular forms cited but not every claim (full paradigm, pronunciation/register, or extra examples); those need narrowing or locators for full coverage.
No canonical Evidence was created and assessEntry did not pass; article unchanged and status not promoted to VERIFIED.
